reshared_post.reshared_text: It's a three-peat! Congrats to Kimi Antonelli on winning his third Grand Prix in a row. Proud to power the high-performance computing that helps drive performance on the track with the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team. Up next, Montreal!
